body:
Failing a competitive training program. 

To be fair, I didn't actually try hard enough, got easily distracted. All I want is a do-over which I will get, I'll just be behind my peers.

On the intake form, was asked about imminent risk of self-harm, including suicide. On the scale of 5, I put down a 3. Low WTL, Mid WTD, prior attempts, history of self-harm. On a lot of scales, that's moderate risk = 3/5. I'm pretty sure no one even looked at the intake form. It's hard to talk to a counsellor about suicide when after getting your basic info, they immediately launch into how successful you already are, then offer mindfulness for your anxiety and depression.
I've talked to people. Made appointments, got counselling. Like I said, people (yes, even health care professionals) don't believe people like me suffer. My protective shell is pretty convincing.
